title: Fireworks Optimization
description: A lightweight performance-focused modpack that makes Minecraft smoother, faster, and more responsive while preserving the vanilla experience. Reduced stutters and optimized performance.
body: # what will you get? - smooth performance - shaders - easy zoom - fullbright - and more # How to install • download modrinth app\ • Install the FPS Fireworks Optimized on "Browse" in the app.\ • and enjoy your game :)
